name: crm
description: A sales CRM. Internal notes are not customer-visible; emails are. Deleting a contact is permanent.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, company, or email. Read-only. Use when you do not have the contact id.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by its exact contact id. Read-only.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact.

tools.name: log_activity
tools.description: Record an internal note or activity on a contact. Not visible to the customer. Use for internal notes like interest level or call summaries.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to a contact. Customer-visible. Use only when the intent is to communicate with the customer, not to record an internal note.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact. Irreversible. Only call when explicitly asked to delete or permanently remove a record.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Create a sales deal or opportunity linked to a contact.
